name: hivewatch
description: Live Beadhive status in a Claude Code pane: in-flight beads, per-agent liveness, molecule progress

hives.title: Hives to watch
hives.description: Comma-separated bh hive ids (for example github/SimplicityGuy/phaze). Leave empty to watch the hive of the session's working directory.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often to poll bh. Each poll runs a few bh commands per hive, so keep this at 10 or more.
